The '''''Dallust''''' was an [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] that was assigned to the fleet that protected the [[Tallaan]] and the [[Tallaani Shipyards]]. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Riesa]]'' was also assigned to this task.<ref name="LOTE" />
